title: Session and login hardening
summary: Login now throttles repeated failures, sessions slide their expiry on activity, and the legacy token endpoint is gone.

scenarios.action: fail login five times in a row from the same IP
scenarios.outcome: further attempts get 429 with a Retry-After hint for 15 minutes

scenarios.action: submit the login form with a registered email and the correct password
scenarios.outcome: the user lands on the tasks page, the session cookie is set, and its expiry slides forward on each authenticated request

scenarios.action: open a protected page with a valid cookie from a logged-out device
scenarios.outcome: the session is rejected server-side and the user is redirected to the login page

scenarios.action: call the removed /api/auth/token endpoint with a legacy token
scenarios.outcome: the API returns 404 and the docs point to session cookies
